stories.headline: A record Atlantic season passes with no hurricane at all
stories.summary: The Atlantic hurricane season started on June 1 and has now gone 103 days without a hurricane. That is a record for the satellite era. The last season to stay quiet this long was 1941, and forecasters point to El Niño in the Pacific Ocean as a big factor.

stories.headline: Kyrgyzstan starts printing its own banknotes
stories.summary: The Kyrgyz National Bank reports that Kyrgyzstan has started printing banknotes of the Kyrgyz som at home. The som is the country's currency. It is the first time the notes have been printed domestically since independence.

stories.headline: A maths strategy solves Wordle 99% of the time
stories.summary: Researchers at Binghamton University have built a mathematical strategy for Wordle. It uses Shannon entropy, a way of measuring uncertainty, to pick the guess that reveals the most information rather than the likeliest answer. In simulations it solved 99% of puzzles, against 90% for a strategy built on common letters.
